Container.Name: RTL88xxAU USB WiFi Driver (rtw88)
Container.Overview:
[b]In-kernel rtw88 (mac80211) USB Wi-Fi driver for Realtek RTL88xxAU chipsets.[/b][br][br] Builds and installs the rtw88 A-series chip modules that Unraid ships disabled (CONFIG_RTW88_8821AU is not set), plus their firmware, giving you a wlan0 interface you configure in Settings -> Network Settings. Because rtw88 is a mac80211 driver, [b]WPA3-SAE / PMF work[/b] (verified on RTL8811AU). Modules are rebuilt automatically per Unraid kernel release.[br][br]
[b]Supported chipsets[/b][br] - RTL8811AU / RTL8821AU (AC600)[br] - RTL8812AU (AC1200)[br] - RTL8814AU (AC1900)[br][br]
[b]Known adapters[/b] (non-exhaustive; the driver binds by USB ID)[br] RTL8811AU/8821AU: TP-Link Archer T2U Nano / T2U Plus / T2U v3, D-Link DWA-171, Edimax EW-7811UAC / EW-7811UTC, Netgear A6100, ASUS USB-AC51.[br] RTL8812AU: TP-Link Archer T4U / T4UH, ASUS USB-AC56, Alfa AWUS036AC / AWUS036ACH, D-Link DWA-182, Netgear A6210, Edimax EW-7822UAC, Tenda U12.[br] RTL8814AU: TP-Link Archer T9UH, ASUS USB-AC68, Alfa AWUS1900, D-Link DWA-192, Netgear A7000.[br][br]

[b]Notes[/b][br] - Set your Country/Region in Network Settings, or 5 GHz channels stay scan-only (no-IR).[br] - Host-only: wlan0 cannot be bridged into br0, so Docker/VM bridged networking won't ride over it.[br] - After an Unraid OS upgrade, a matching driver release is built automatically (within ~24h).
